title: kit.dated-registry.v1
description: The shape every registry that records a fact read from outside (a plan, a subprocessor, a provider's limit) takes: a top-level `max_age_days` and, on each fact, a `verified` day (YYYY-MM-DD). `kit check staleness` reports registry-fact-stale for any fact older than its max age (the fact's own max_age_days, else the registry's) and for a registry with a `verified` day and no declared max age. A registry schema references this one with allOf and adds its own facts.

max_age_days.description: The oldest a `verified` day in this registry may be before the fact is stale.

verified.description: The day the fact was read from its source.
